items.name: Cane Pistol
items.description: This fashionable cane's handle hides a dueling pistol fired through the thin, painted cap at the bottom of the cane.

items.name: Dueling Pistol
items.description: Made for settling disputes when diplomacy fails, dueling pistols are finely crafted and made to fit easily into a holster or pocket. Noble and wealthy merchants in both Alkenstar and Dongun Hold often own matching pairs of dueling pistols in case they're called upon to address a challenge-though this practice has become increasingly rare in the modern age.

items.name: Rounds (Cane Pistol)
items.description: Firearms require ammunition consisting of a projectile and black powder. A round of ammo can vary in its composition but is typically either a prepackaged paper cartridge, including wadding, bullet, and black powder, or loose shot packed in manually. Some weapons, like hand cannons and blunderbusses, can fire other materials, but their ammunition has the same Price due to the cost of the black powder. Because making rounds of firearm ammunition requires creating black powder, you need the Alchemical Crafting skill feat to make them. Firearm rounds are a valid option for magical ammunition, just like arrows or bolts. Crafting magical firearm ammunition requires you to be able to craft both alchemical and magical items.

items.name: Eroding Bullet
items.description:
Ammunition round

Activate Interact

Eroding bullets cast a faint green glow, and smell like the sickly- sweet organic gases that rise from corpses. Handling an eroding bullet without gloves deals 1 acid damage and leaves the putrid scent coated on your fingers. Upon Striking an enemy, the glass casing inside the bullet bursts, releasing a splattering of bubbling green acid that coats the target. The target takes 2d6 persistent plus acid damage in addition to the damage normally dealt by the attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Deny Advantage
defensiveAbilities.description: Mugland isn't Off-Guard to creatures of 8th level or lower that are Hidden, Undetected, flanking, or using Surprise Attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Evasion
defensiveAbilities.description: When Mugland rolls a success on a Reflex save, he gets a critical success instead.

defensiveAbilities.name: Exploit Blunder
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet rolls a critical failure to Strike Mugland

Effect With a sneer, Mugland takes advantage of the opening. He makes a ranged dueling pistol or cane pistol Strike against the triggering creature. The creature is Off-Guard to Mugland's attacks (including this one) until the beginning of its next turn. This attack doesn't count toward Mugland's multiple attack penalty, and his multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Slippery Dodge
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Mugland is hit by a Strike, but wouldn't be hit with a +2 circumstance bonus to AC

Effect Mugland gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack and the attack misses.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Draw
offensiveAbilities.description: Mugland Interacts to draw a weapon, then Strikes with that weapon.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Mugland deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.
